They taste the same as the ones with sugar. They're also very fresh!
The licorice was fresher than in a movie theater and tastes wonderful!
Not fresh the flavor is okay
features.summary: Customers appreciate the freshness of these candy twists, with one noting they are even fresher than those found in movie theaters.

features.name: texture
quotes: Enjoyed the taste and texture of these twizzlers!!
Hard, dry, plasticky, could not eat.
My mom who is a diabetic loves these! It gives her the Twizzler texture without the sugar. This is my second batch of them.
The flavor was good but I didn’t like the texture
features.summary: Customers have mixed opinions about the texture of these sugar-free Twizzlers, with some loving it while others find it very hard.

features.name: chewability
quotes: The taste is still there and they were fresh and nice and chewy....
I can eat almost any candy and be happy but this was like chewing an electrical cord. I bit into it and they were not chewy....
These are YUMMY. So yummy that I could again eat the whole pack. Other than the consistency, I barely know they are sugar free....
They have the aftertaste of a twizzler but it's like chewing on straight paraffin wax. They really are awful....
features.summary: Customers have mixed opinions about the candy's chewability, with some finding it chewy while others say it's not very chewable.

features.name: value for money
quotes: Expensive, but the taste is great. It has an identical taste to regular Twizzlers.
I like the fact it was sugar free because I am diabetic....a little pricey though, but have not been able to find in a local store.
At 50usd now they are way too expensive.If price halfs its a good deal for 12 packs.
If you dont plan on leaving the house for 24 hours it is worth it.
features.summary: Customers find the candy to be a poor value, noting that there isn't enough product in the package for the price and describing it as a huge rip-off.

features.name: digestibility
quotes: Tasty but the digestive impact is severe even in small, calibrated doses....
Whatever ingredients are in it they cause bad digestive issues to people that already have GI problems. Can’t eat more than one or two unfortunately
Not long after; I had major intestinal pain, gas & bloating. Horrible cramping all night. Husband had bouts of flatulency & lower bowel pressure too!...
They taste really good but they hurt my stomach so much I would not buy these again.
features.summary: Customers report that the candy causes digestive issues, including upset stomach, diarrhea, and nausea.
